name: gemini-cli
description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
one_liner: A free terminal tool from Google that lets you chat with its Gemini AI to read code, fix bugs, and automate coding tasks directly from the command line.
buyer: A developer or small dev team already using Google Cloud or a Gemini subscription who wants an AI coding assistant without paying for a separate tool.
business_use_cases: A development agency already on Google Cloud standardizes on it for client coding work instead of paying for a second AI coding subscription.
A freelance developer uses its scripting mode to automate repetitive tasks like rebasing branches or triaging pull requests across many client repos.
An enterprise using Vertex AI wires it into CI pipelines for automated code review or doc generation tasks.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell MCP server integrations that connect gemini-cli to niche business tools a company already uses.
Offer setup and automation consulting for teams that want to wire gemini-cli into their CI/CD pipeline.

steal_this: Note is already being superseded by Google's own Antigravity CLI per the repo's own README — a 'steal this' here is really just migrating existing gemini-cli automations rather than building new business on it.
